lines.en: label harukadate5:
I wonder if Haruka is doing anything tonight?
lines.zh: 不知道 Haruka 今晚有没有什么事？

lines.en: Now that I think about it, the two of us haven’t really hung out since that night at the bar.
lines.zh: 仔细想想，自从那天在酒吧之后，我们俩就再没怎么一起待过了。

lines.en: Which...definitely makes sense, given the circumstances.
lines.zh: 考虑到当时的情况……这也确实合情合理。

lines.en: Whether or not the alcohol had any influence over Haruka’s decision to shove her tongue down my throat doesn’t change the fact that it happened.
lines.zh: 不管酒精在多大程度上左右了 Haruka 把舌头伸进我嘴里的决定，事情既然已经发生了，这一点就不会改变。

lines.en: And knowing that most people have a much stronger moral compass than I do, I imagine she’s pretty confused about that right now.
lines.zh: 我知道大多数人的道德感都比我强得多，所以我想她现在大概挺迷茫的。

lines.en: I would be too, in her position.
lines.zh: 换成我是她，也会一样。

lines.en: But that doesn’t change the fact that I want to see her.
lines.zh: 但这并不影响我想见她这件事。

lines.en: And so I tap on her name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 于是我点开手机里她的名字，等着她接。

lines.en: : Hello?...
: Hey, it’s me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，是我。

lines.en: : Yeah, hey. Uhh...what's up? Is...
lines.zh: : 啊，嗨。呃……怎么了？是不是……

lines.en: : Is everything okay with Rin?
lines.zh: : Rin 那边没事吧？

lines.en: : Rin? Yeah.
lines.zh: : Rin？嗯。

lines.en: : Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 为什么这么问？

lines.en: : I...don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……

lines.en: : I just figured that since you were calling, it probably had something to do with her.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你既然打电话过来，多半是跟她有关的事。

lines.en: : So...does this mean I can’t call you to hang out anymore? You're pulling the plug after one time?
lines.zh: : 所以……意思是以后我不能打电话约你出来了吗？才一次你就打退堂鼓了？

lines.en: An awkward silence separates the two of us more than even the phone does. I can’t tell exactly what she’s thinking, but I know it's nothing good.
lines.zh: 一阵尴尬的沉默隔开了我们，比那通电话隔得还要彻底。我说不清她到底在想什么，但我知道那绝不是什么好事。

lines.en: : I mean...you {i}can.{/i} It’s just...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……你{i}可以{/i}打。只是……

lines.en: : It's probably not a good idea.
lines.zh: : 这大概不是什么好主意。

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : It’s..kind of hard to explain...
lines.zh: : 这……有点难解释……

lines.en: : Then it would probably be better to do it in person.
lines.zh: : 那大概还是当面说比较好。

lines.en: : I guess...
lines.zh: : 大概吧……

lines.en: : Did you want to come over?
lines.zh: : 你要过来吗？

lines.en: : Huh? To your place? Is that really okay?
lines.zh: : 啊？去你家？真的可以吗？

lines.en: : Well, my [niece] will probably come home soon. But as long as I tell her, it’s-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我 [niece] 大概快回来了。不过只要我跟她说一声，就——

lines.en: : Just-
: Just...come over here.
lines.zh: : 你……还是来我这儿吧。

lines.en: : Do you need me to pick you up?
lines.zh: : 要我去接你吗？

lines.en: : Nah. I remember where it is.
lines.zh: : 不用。我还记得路。

lines.en: : I’ll be there soon.
lines.zh: : 我很快就到。

lines.en: : ...Okay.
: I’ll see you then.
lines.zh: : 那待会儿见。

lines.en: scene black
Now, I know what you’re probably thinking.
lines.zh: 好了，我知道你现在大概在想什么。

lines.en: Should I really be taking advantage of a lonely woman who is clearly missing her husband right now?
lines.zh: 我真的该趁虚而入，去占一个显然正在思念丈夫的孤独女人的便宜吗？

lines.en: And the answer is probably no.
lines.zh: 答案大概是不该。

lines.en: But Haruka’s husband is likely never coming back.
lines.zh: 但 Haruka 的丈夫很可能永远不会回来了。

lines.en: And {i}I’m{/i} here right now.
lines.zh: 而{i}我{/i}此刻就在这里。

lines.en: She deserves someone that can make her feel whole again.
lines.zh: 她值得有个人让她重新觉得自己是完整的。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo1
: Hey. Thanks for dropping by.
lines.zh: : 嘿。谢谢你过来。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it. I wanted to see you anyway.
lines.zh: : 别客气。我本来就挺想见你的。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo2
: Yeah...That’s kind of what I wanted to talk about.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想说的其实也就是这个。

lines.en: : You see, I haven’t really been...entirely honest with you.
lines.zh: : 是这样的，其实我一直……没有对你完全说实话。

lines.en: : And the other night...when I got drunk...I just sort of acted on impulse and-
lines.zh: : 那天晚上……我喝醉的时候……我只是一时冲动，就——

lines.en: : And took what you wanted without thinking about it...right?
lines.zh: : 然后想都没想，就拿了你想要的东西……对吧？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo3
: Ngh...
: Yes...
lines.zh: : 是的……

lines.en: : I took what I wanted.
lines.zh: : 我拿了想要的东西。

lines.en: : But I really shouldn’t have...
lines.zh: : 但我真的不该那么做……

lines.en: : It was a stupid decision and I should have had the willpower to prevent it, drunk or not.
lines.zh: : 那是个愚蠢的决定。不管醉没醉，我都该有自制力拦住自己。

lines.en: : Well, what's the look for? You're not angry at {i}me,{/i} are you?
lines.zh: : 那这副表情是为什么？你不是在生{i}我{/i}的气吧？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo4
: What? No, it’s just...
lines.zh: : 什么？不是，只是……

lines.en: : Rin told you, didn’t she? About my...situation.
lines.zh: : Rin 告诉你了吧？关于我的……情况。

lines.en: : Your {i}situation?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你的{i}情况{/i}？

lines.en: Of course I know what she’s talking about. But simply coming out and doing all of the work {i}for{/i} Haruka isn’t going to do anything for her.
lines.zh: 我当然知道她在说什么。但就这么直接摊牌、{i}替{/i} Haruka 把话全说了，对她一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: She’s the one who got herself into this mess. And sure, I didn’t do anything to prevent it, but why would I?
lines.zh: 是她自己把自己弄进这团乱麻里的。没错，我没阻止过，可我为什么要阻止？

lines.en: Because it’s wrong?
lines.zh: 因为这样不对？

lines.en: A lot of things I do are wrong.
lines.zh: 我做的很多事都不对。

lines.en: If anything, this seems pretty tame by those standards.
lines.zh: 要说的话，按那个标准，这事还算温和的。

lines.en: : You...really don’t know?
lines.zh: : 你……真的不知道？

lines.en: : I never said that. I just want to hear it from you instead of one of my students.
lines.zh: : 我可没说过不知道。我只是想听你亲口说，而不是从我的某个学生那儿听说。

lines.en: : We're both adults. We should be acting like it- not dancing around our feelings because we're afraid of them.
lines.zh: : 我们都是成年人了。就该有个成年人的样子——别因为害怕，就绕着自己的感情打转。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo5
: Yeah...Yeah, that’s fair. I guess I at least owe you that much.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，你说得对。我想我至少欠你这么多。

lines.en: : You don’t owe me anything.
lines.zh: : 你什么都不欠我。

lines.en: : No, I do. I was leading you on.
lines.zh: : 不，我欠。我一直在吊着你。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo6
: I'm married...
lines.zh: : 我结婚了……

lines.en: : And I...have no idea why I've been hiding that from you.
lines.zh: : 而我……完全不明白自己为什么要瞒着你。

lines.en: Liar.
lines.zh: 骗人。

lines.en: : It’s not your fault...and I hold absolutely nothing against you, but that doesn’t change the fact that I need to stop things now before they go any further.
lines.zh: : 这不是你的错……我也一点也不怪你，但这改变不了一个事实——我必须趁着还没走得更远，现在就把事情停下。

lines.en: : What happened at the bar was nothing more than an...outburst fueled by alcohol and loneliness.
lines.zh: : 在酒吧发生的那件事，不过是……酒精和孤独促成的一次失控。

lines.en: if sarainterest == True:
: Besides, you already told me you’re into Sara and-
lines.zh: : 再说，你本来就说过你喜欢 Sara，而且——

lines.en: : What does Sara have to do with this?
lines.zh: : Sara 跟这件事有什么关系？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo7
: Sara has a ton to do with this. She likes you {i}way{/i} more than me...and it would be wrong on so many levels for me to keep acting on my feelings without thinking about hers.
lines.zh: : Sara 跟这事关系大了。她喜欢你{i}远{/i}胜过喜欢我……要是我只顾着自己的感情，完全不考虑她的，那无论从哪方面说都是错的。

lines.en: : And what are {i}your{/i} feelings, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你的{/i}感情呢，Haruka？

lines.en: : Stupid...that's what.
lines.zh: : 很蠢……就这么回事。

lines.en: : My feelings are stupid and I’m stupid for having them.
lines.zh: : 我的感情很蠢，而我因为怀有这种感情，本身就很蠢。

lines.en: I can’t find it in myself to respond to her right now.
lines.zh: 我此刻找不到话来回应她。

lines.en: Instead, I watch as her gaze gets trapped within the same walls she likely imagined raising a family inside of.
lines.zh: 我只是看着她的目光被困在这四堵墙里——她大概曾经幻想过，要在这屋子里养大一个家。

lines.en: There is no escape. Not now. Not ever.
lines.zh: 无路可逃。现在没有。永远也不会有。

lines.en: else:
: Besides...there's still the whole thing with Sara and-
lines.zh: : 再说……还有 Sara 那边的事，而且——

lines.en: : What does Sara have to do with this?
lines.zh: : Sara 跟这件事有什么关系？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo7
: More than you realize.
lines.zh: : 比你以为的要多得多。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much she likes you?...
lines.zh: : 你知道她有多喜欢你吗？……

lines.en: : Sara and I barely even know each other. Whatever she thinks she's feeling is fake.
lines.zh: : Sara 和我根本算不上认识。她自以为的那种感情是假的。

lines.en: : She’s nothing more than a student’s mother to me. And I already told you I’m not interested in her.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，她不过是个学生的母亲。而且我说过了，我对她没兴趣。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo6
: But if you’re not interested in her, then...
lines.zh: : 可既然你对她没兴趣，那……

lines.en: A long pause, as if she’s waiting for me to fill in the blanks.
lines.zh: 一段长长的停顿，像是她在等我把空白填上。

lines.en: But I don’t. I wait for her to fill them in herself.
lines.zh: 但我没有。我等着她自己填上去。

lines.en: : Are you interested in {i}me?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你对……{i}我{/i}有兴趣吗？……

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo7
: I don’t...understand why you would be when someone much more compatible and...unmarried is already throwing herself at you.
lines.zh: : 我不明白……明明有个更合适、而且……还没结婚的人主动投怀送抱，你为什么会对我有兴趣。

lines.en: : I’m just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I’m just...really lonely.
lines.zh: : 我只是……真的很孤独。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo8
: And I’m sure that sounds like a stupid complaint for someone our age, but...I really {i}am{/i} lonely...
lines.zh: : 我知道，在我们这个年纪说这种话，听起来像个愚蠢的抱怨，可是……我{i}是真的{/i}孤独……

lines.en: : Do you have any idea what it’s like having the person you’ve dedicated yourself to just...disappear one day?
lines.zh: : 你知道那种感觉吗——你把整个人都托付给了一个人，然后某一天，他就这么……消失了？

lines.en: : To have your entire life stripped away from you without so much as a warning?
lines.zh: : 连一句提醒都没有，整个人生就被从你身上生生剥走？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo9
: I don’t even know where he is?! Or what he’s doing! Or-
lines.zh: : 我甚至不知道他在哪儿？！在干什么？！或者——

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo10

lines.zh: : 或者……

lines.en: : Or if he’s even still alive...
lines.zh: : 或者……他是不是还活着……

lines.en: : And like...I {i}do{/i} love him...Really...I love him so much...
lines.zh: : 而且……我{i}是{/i}爱他的……真的……我那么爱他……

lines.en: : But I...I can't control my thoughts...I want to, but I can't.
lines.zh: : 可是我……我控制不了自己的想法……我想控制，但做不到。

lines.en: : They just keep going and going and going and going and-
lines.zh: : 它们就这么一直转、一直转、一直转、一直转，然后——

lines.en: Bullshit.
lines.zh: 放屁。

lines.en: That’s not love.
lines.zh: 那不是爱。

lines.en: When you’re in love, you don’t stare into someone else’s eyes after a night of drinking and drag them into the issues you’re afraid of facing on your own.
lines.zh: 真爱一个人，你不会在一夜痛饮之后盯着别人的眼睛，把人家拖进你自己不敢面对的问题里。

lines.en: You don’t bite down on their lip or lean into them as they massage your chest.
lines.zh: 你不会咬住人家的嘴唇，也不会在人家揉你胸口的时候往对方身上贴。

lines.en: You stay away from all of that.
lines.zh: 你会远离这一切。

lines.en: Haruka doesn't love her husband at all.
lines.zh: Haruka 根本不爱她丈夫。

lines.en: If she did, I wouldn't be here.
lines.zh: 如果她爱，我就不会在这儿了。

lines.en: : I get it.
lines.zh: : 我明白。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo11
: You do?...
lines.zh: : 你明白？……

lines.en: : Of course I do. I can’t even imagine going as long as you have without sex.
lines.zh: : 当然明白。我甚至无法想象，像你这样熬那么久没有性生活是什么感觉。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo12
: I mean it's...it's more than just that...
lines.zh: : 我是说，这……不只是因为那个……

lines.en: : Sex is only...part of it...
lines.zh: : 性只是……其中一部分……

lines.en: : I...miss feeling wanted. Or loved. Or pretty or desirable or any other good thing that I felt before I was all alone.
lines.zh: : 我……想念被人想要的感觉。或者被爱。或者觉得自己漂亮、有魅力——或者在孤身一人之前，我曾经感受过的任何美好的东西。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo13
: The sex thing...definitely makes it worse, though. I won't lie.
lines.zh: : 不过性那方面……确实让情况更糟。这点我不骗你。

lines.en: : I was never really interested in that kind of stuff when I was younger but, like...as soon as I started, it became really hard to hold back whenever I-
lines.zh: : 年轻的时候我对那种事其实没什么兴趣，可是……一旦尝过滋味，之后就很难再忍住了，每次我——

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo14
: Ugh...What the fuck am I even saying to you right now?! Talking about this is just going to make it even worse!
lines.zh: : 呃……我到底在跟你说些什么啊？！说这些只会让情况变得更糟！

lines.en: : Talk as much as you want, Haruka. I don’t mind things like this.
lines.zh: : 想说多少就说多少，Haruka。我不介意这种事。

lines.en: : I do want you to know that there are plenty of people who still think you’re pretty or desirable or whatever it is you want to hear, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我确实想让你知道，觉得你漂亮、觉得你有魅力的人有的是——或者任何你想听到的那些话，都成立。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo15
: Knowing that just makes it harder...
lines.zh: : 知道这些只会让我更难受……

lines.en: : Why? Didn’t you say you just wanted to feel that way again?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你不是说，你只是想重新找回那种感觉吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but not when feeling that way makes me think I’m some...unfaithful {i}slut{/i} who misses sex so much that she cheats on her husband while he's away.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可每当找回那种感觉，我就会觉得自己是个……不忠的{i}荡妇{/i}，就因为太想做爱，才在丈夫不在的时候给他戴绿帽。

lines.en: : How long has he been away, if you don’t mind me asking?
lines.zh: : 冒昧问一句，他走了多久了？

lines.en: : Three years, I think.
lines.zh: : 三年吧，我想。

lines.en: : Three years? How are you even alive?
lines.zh: : 三年？你是怎么活下来的？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo16
: Is that supposed to make me feel better?!
lines.zh: : 你这么说是在安慰我吗？！

lines.en: : I'm sorry. That's just...longer than I thought.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是……比我以为的要久。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo17
: I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : Honestly, I probably {i}would{/i} be dead if it wasn't for the local porn shop.
lines.zh: : 说实话，要不是有那家本地成人用品店，我大概{i}早就{/i}死了。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo16
: Ugh! And now I’m doing it again!
lines.zh: : 呃！我又来了！

lines.en: : You know, this is also kind of your fault for being so attractive and...making me think things!
lines.zh: : 说真的，这也怪你长得太好看，还……害我胡思乱想！

lines.en: : Am I...supposed to apologize for that?
lines.zh: : 这……需要我道歉吗？

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo17

lines.zh: : 不用，我……

lines.en: : My mind has just been wandering all over the place lately.
lines.zh: : 我最近脑子里总是到处乱飘。

lines.en: : And more often than not, I feel like it winds up stopping somewhere near you.
lines.zh: : 而且大多数时候，它最后都停在你附近。

lines.en: Ahh, there it is. The admission I’ve been waiting for since this conversation started.
lines.zh: 啊，来了。从这场对话开始，我一直在等的那句坦白。

lines.en: From this point on, there are two options.
lines.zh: 从这里开始，有两个选项。

lines.en: Either I be a good guy and don’t take advantage of Haruka in this moment of desperation- dooming her to wait for a man who may never even return.
lines.zh: 要么我当个好人，不趁 Haruka 绝望的时候占她便宜——让她就这么等下去，等一个也许永远不会回来的男人。

lines.en: Or-
lines.zh: 要么——

lines.en: I seduce her.
lines.zh: 我勾引她。

lines.en: And remind her of all the wonderful things she’s been missing out on inside of these walls.
lines.zh: 然后让她想起，在这些墙壁之内，她错过了多少美妙的东西。

lines.en: What should I do?
lines.zh: 我该怎么做？

lines.en: menu:
Be a gentleman
lines.zh: 当个绅士

lines.en: : I should probably leave before this turns into something you’ll regret.
lines.zh: : 我大概该走了，趁这事还没变成你会后悔的东西。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo18
A sigh of relief spreads across Haruka’s face.
lines.zh: Haruka 脸上浮现出如释重负的叹息。

lines.en: Her shoulders drop and cause her breasts to bounce which, for a brief moment, remind me of all the joys I will now be missing out on.
lines.zh: 她的肩膀垮下来，带得胸部也跟着一颤，那一瞬间让我想起了自己即将错过的所有快乐。

lines.en: But the fact is-
lines.zh: 可事实是——

lines.en: I have no place in this woman’s life right now.
lines.zh: 此刻，我在这个女人的生活里没有位置。

lines.en: Not while she is this conflicted.
lines.zh: 在她如此矛盾的时候，没有。

lines.en: If I am going to take her, I need her mind to be on me and me only.
lines.zh: 如果我要得到她，我需要她心里只有我一个人。

lines.en: Besides, I have plenty of other girls who are throwing themselves at me on a daily basis.
lines.zh: 再说了，每天主动投怀送抱的女孩我多得是。

lines.en: So what if this one is sex-starved and ready to go right now?
lines.zh: 这个渴求性爱、现在就准备好了，那又怎样？

lines.en: It's not like going three years without sex might make her go all out and-
lines.zh: 又不是说憋了三年，她就会在床上使出浑身解数，然后——

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. I really do need to get going. My mind is heading in a dangerous direction right now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我确实得走了。我的脑子正在往危险的方向跑。

lines.en: scene harukadatetwo19
